negative_reviews.author: Layton
negative_reviews.text:
We had a bit of a strange experience here. The app charged me for sushi that I’d removed from my basket, which I didn’t realise until after I’d paid. I mentioned it to the waiter, who seemed just as baffled, so I ended up keeping the sushi anyway. Unfortunately, it was some of the worst sushi I’ve had.

The app also automatically adds a tip, which you have to manually remove from your total. I find that quite odd? why am I being asked to tip before I’ve even had my food or received any service? Why am I being asked to tip at all for a QR code?

The ramen broth was definitely the highlight of the meal, but overall, the rest was pretty disappointing especially as we were celebrating a birthday. Hopefully some improvements to the app and food quality are made, as there’s potential here.
